title: Brief
description: companion → plugin. One request, one conversation. Exactly one request is open per conversation at a time.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.

reason.description: The platform's ring-reason vocabulary, carried through verbatim.

cause.description: The recorded human cause this request answers. The plugin uses the cause's author as the inbound sender.

deadline.description: After which the companion expires the request; the plugin need not enforce it.

sinceCursor.description: Exclusive lower bound; null for a conversation's first brief.

throughCursor.description: Inclusive upper bound, fixed when the request opened. A redelivered brief recomputes the same range.

resetSession.description: The platform forces a fresh harness session; the plugin must not resume.

delta.description: (sinceCursor, throughCursor], with the answering agent's OWN entries omitted — those arrive in the opener.

context.description: OPTIONAL — absent from an older companion. When present, the plugin places it on the system side of EVERY turn, fresh or resumed, so an edit lands on the next answer.
